description: Deitma Doering v. W.H. Thamara Doering and Another Deitma Doering v. W.H. Thamara Doering and Another View More before Hon. Eric Basnayake, J.
parties: Deitma Doering v. W.H. Thamara Doering and Another Deitma Doering v. W.H. Thamara Doering and Another View More
keywords: Leave to Appeal; The Petitioner challenged the District Court’s decision to postpone ruling on objections to issues concerning gross ingratitude arising from a deed of gift. Held - the pleaded facts were sufficient to permit those issues to be raised, although the District Judge should have ruled on the objections immediately rather than at the end of trial. Appeal partly allowed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
